# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi

"""Publish closed individual samples; retain pinned receipts, retire duplicate logs."""
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import re

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/perf-native-copy-cohorts-qualified-20261012')
F = W / 'bench/results/2026-10-13-long-decode128-worker-screen'
R = B / 'research-20261009'
L = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.lint')
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('cohort_publication_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
ENV = dict(PATH=str(L / 'venv/bin') + ':' + str(L / 'bin') + ':/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi',
           LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8', GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0', GIT_SSH_COMMAND='ssh -oBatchMode=yes')
prior_env = json.loads((B / 'latest-update-main-finalization-host-root-v8/record.json').read_text())['environment']
for key in ['RUBYLIB', 'GEM_PATH']:
    ENV[key] = prior_env[key]


def dump(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')


def hashes(value, key=''):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: hashes(v, k) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [hashes(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, str) and key != 'sha256' and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', value):
        return dict(sha256=value)
    return value


def load_closed(path, expected_pass=True):
    data = json.loads(path.read_text())
    assert data['passed'] is expected_pass and not data['active']
    if expected_pass:
        assert data['complete']
    for command in data.get('commands', []) + data.get('guard_commands', []):
        assert m.closed(command) and command['session_anchored']
    return data


with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'main-long-decode128-cohort-publication-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists() and not F.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    F.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, complete=False, passed=False, commands=[], evidence={},
             main_reviewed=True, gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False)

    def save():
        dump(out / 'record.json', r)

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands

    def run(label, argv, allowed=(0,)):
        command, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, ENV, W, wall=300, cpu=1800,
                                    rss_cap=8 << 30, text_cap=16 << 20, total_cap=48 << 20)
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(command) and command['session_anchored'] and command['exit_code'] in allowed, label
        return so.read_text().strip()

    try:
        assert run('source-head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']) == 'e3c904e2e2247826f758ef0e682e2e7051152b86'
        assert not run('initial-status', ['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
        assert not run('local-identity', ['git', 'config', '--local', '--get-regexp', r'^user\.(name|email)$'], (1,))
        run('author-identity', ['git', 'var', 'GIT_AUTHOR_IDENT'])
        derivations = []
        closed_roots = []

        def archive_receipt(path, label, expected_pass=True):
            data = load_closed(path, expected_pass)
            target = F / 'receipts' / (label + '.json')
            dump(target, hashes(data))
            derivations.append(dict(original_path=str(path), original_sha256=m.sha(path),
                                    public_path=str(target.relative_to(F)), public_sha256=m.sha(target),
                                    transformation='Typed SHA values; original receipt bytes and status unchanged.'))
            closed_roots.append((path.parent, data, str(target.relative_to(F))))
            return data

        archive_receipt(B / 'main-long-decode128-host-qualification-root-v3/record.json', 'host-v4-controller')
        archive_receipt(B / 'main-long-decode128-host-qualification-root-v4/record.json', 'host-v5-controller')
        admission = archive_receipt(B / 'main-long-decode128-admission-root-v2/record.json', 'admission-v5-controller')
        assert admission['python_no_new_findings']
        failed = archive_receipt(B / 'main-long-decode128-root-v4/sample-1-workers-5-gu-unchanged/xe-timed1-on/record.json',
                                 'v4-mapping-segment-parser-failure', False)
        assert not failed['model_launch_attempted'] and failed['kernel_gate_passed'] and failed['boot_unchanged']
        health_path = B / 'main-long-decode128-root-v4/sample-1-workers-5-gu-unchanged/xe-timed1-on/commands/health-before.stdout'
        health_lines = health_path.read_text().splitlines()
        libraries = Counter(line.removeprefix('LIBRARY ') for line in health_lines if line.startswith('LIBRARY '))
        assert sum(libraries.values()) == 29 and len(libraries) == 7
        assert 'PASS 0000:05:00.0: 1 round, 16384 exact words' in health_lines
        dump(F / 'resolved-health-parser-evidence.json', dict(
            original_path=str(health_path), sha256=m.sha(health_path), original_result='failed-before-model',
            original_failure=failed['error'], probe_progress=[line for line in health_lines if not line.startswith('LIBRARY ')],
            mapping_rows=29, unique_libraries=7, library_mapping_segment_counts=dict(libraries),
            correction='Repeated rows represent ELF mappings; bounded rows plus exact library identity-set admission.',
            status_unchanged=True))
        samples = []
        for i, n in [(1, 5), (2, 3), (3, 4), (4, 4)]:
            path = B / f'main-long-decode128-root-v5/sample-{i}-workers-{n}-gu-unchanged/xe-timed1-on/record.json'
            if i == 4 and not path.exists():
                continue
            d = archive_receipt(path, f'sample-{i}-workers-{n}')
            assert d['performance_sample_eligible'] and d['model_normal_close'] and d['kernel_gate_passed']
            assert d['boot_unchanged'] and not d['quality_evaluated'] and not d['quality_qualified']
            assert d['qualification_sha256'] == '8bcf9db06bf6a1c8d47540284eed5319ad8ba8be9d217248a1bbe17d0737ec13'
            v = d['validation']
            assert v['prompt_tokens'] == 32768 and v['generated_tokens'] == 128
            stderr = (path.parent / 'commands/engine.stderr').read_text().splitlines()
            patterns = ('memory guard:', 'this CPU has no AVX-512:', 'native pack:', 'weights loaded',
                        'native projection matrices,', 'KV streaming:', 'PLE table format', 'PLE on, table',
                        'experimental native', 'expert arena:', 'loaded 46.84 GiB', 'ranked pairs,',
                        'per-layer slots use', 'expert cache 144 slots', 'PER-LAYER:', 'pre-filled',
                        'expert-pool workers', 'GDN step forms', "PCIe share's fetch", 'BF16 GEMV',
                        'session is up', 'expert residency table:', 'prompt path allocates',
                        'queue-completed host/device handoff', 'window up to', 'VRAM free',
                        'captured the 1-token window', 'strata serve: prompt', 'decode expert cache hit rate')
            diagnostics = [line for line in stderr if any(p in line for p in patterns)]
            samples.append(dict(sample=i, workers=n, pool_tasks=d['pool_tasks'],
                                prefill_ms=v['engine_prefill_ms'], decode_ms=v['engine_decode_ms'],
                                prefill_tps=32768000 / v['engine_prefill_ms'], decode_tps=128000 / v['engine_decode_ms'],
                                startup_seconds=d['startup_wall_seconds_observed'],
                                full128_token_logprob_sha256=v['token_logprob_sha256'],
                                first16_comparison=d['first16_comparison'], stderr_evidence=diagnostics,
                                receipt_path=f'receipts/sample-{i}-workers-{n}.json',
                                original_receipt_sha256=m.sha(path)))
        dump(F / 'individual-samples.json', hashes(samples))
        files = [
            B / 'main-long-decode128-admission-root-v2/qualification.json',
            B / 'main-long-decode128-admission-root-v2/compiled-source-recipe.json',
            B / 'main-long-decode128-admission-root-v2/controller-review.json',
            B / 'main-long-decode128-controller-source-v5/worker-long-decode-v5.py.txt',
            B / 'main-long-decode128-controller-source-v5/worker-long-decode-cpu-fixtures-v5.py.txt',
            B / 'main-long-decode128-controller-source-v4/worker-long-decode-v4.py.txt',
            B / 'main-long-decode128-controller-source-v4/worker-long-decode-cpu-fixtures-v4.py.txt',
            B / 'main-long-decode128-host-qualification-v3.py', B / 'main-long-decode128-host-qualification-v4.py',
            B / 'main-long-decode128-admission-v2.py', Path(__file__)]
        for path in files:
            target = F / 'controllers' / (path.name + '.json')
            value = dict(original_path=str(path), sha256=m.sha(path), bytes=path.stat().st_size)
            if path.suffix == '.json':
                value['data'] = hashes(json.loads(path.read_text()))
            else:
                value['text'] = path.read_text()
            dump(target, value)
        reports = [
            'research-production-fixed-history-quality-hook-round319-v1.txt',
            'research-segmented-decode-handoff-exposed-wait-round320-v1.txt',
            'research-no-mtp-prefill-retirement-decode-cache-growth-round321-v1.txt',
            'research-persistent-serve-prefill-retirement-cache-growth-round322-v1.txt',
            'research-fixed-history-standalone-vs-serve-safety-round323-v1.txt',
            'research-current-adaptive-decode-cache-knob-round324-v1.txt',
            'research-free-decode-dense-head-kernel-criticalpath-round325-v1.txt',
            'research-actual-native-head-dense-format-ledger-round327-v1.txt',
            'research-current-pool-host-affinity-criticalpath-round328-v1.txt',
            'research-current-maxnew16-vs128-route-discriminator-round329-v1.txt',
            'research-actual-serve-no-mtp-maxnew-route-round330-v1.txt',
            'research-fixed-history-full-logit-file-comparator-contract-round331-v1.txt',
            'implementation-prefill-native-copy-queue-source-v1.txt',
            'implementation-phase-decode-cache-growth-source-v1.txt']
        entries = []
        for name in reports:
            path = R / name
            target = F / 'research' / (name + '.json')
            dump(target, dict(original_path=str(path), sha256=m.sha(path), bytes=path.stat().st_size, text=path.read_text()))
            entries.append(dict(path=str(target.relative_to(F)), sha256=m.sha(target)))
        prior = W / 'bench/results/2026-10-13-model-comparison-policy/report-registry-v176.json'
        dump(F / 'report-registry-v177.json', dict(
            research_completed=json.loads(prior.read_text())['research_completed'] + len(entries),
            prior=dict(path='../2026-10-13-model-comparison-policy/report-registry-v176.json', sha256=m.sha(prior)),
            new_reports=entries, main_only_test_execution=True,
            corrections=[
                'R322 corrects R321: persistent Prefill must be re-created for a subsequent GEN after retirement.',
                'R324 default adaptive-swap advice is not active: actual argv sets --adapt-swaps 0.',
                'R330 corrects R329: actual no-MTP/no-draft serve calls T=1 throughout both first16 prefixes.',
                'R323 was overwritten by a legacy agent after its first return. The earlier reported hash bb4a4aa3e15680d43999a4db2fbbabdb7fd09785c536326a7dc8a9330689c406 is not evidence of retained bytes. This registry archives only the verified current version.',
                'R326 was requested but not returned; it is not counted as completed.',
                'All implementation packets are source-only; no new inference implementation was adopted.']))
        packet_info = []
        for name in ['main-prefill-native-copy-queue-source-v1', 'main-phase-decode-cache-growth-source-v1']:
            root = B / name
            packet_info.append(dict(path=str(root), status='source-only', main_tested=False, adopted=False,
                                    files=[dict(path=p.name, bytes=p.stat().st_size, sha256=m.sha(p))
                                           for p in sorted(root.iterdir()) if p.is_file()],
                                    owner='Main', consumer='Main source review and separate future qualified build/fixtures',
                                    byte_budget=512 << 10, next_review='After Main qualification or replacement packet'))
        dump(F / 'implementation-packets.json', packet_info)
        dump(F / 'receipt-derivations.json', derivations)
        rows = '\n'.join(f"| {s['sample']} | {s['workers']} | {s['prefill_ms']:.1f} | {s['decode_ms']:.1f} | {s['prefill_tps']:.3f} | {s['decode_tps']:.4f} |"
                         for s in samples)
        (F / 'REPORT.md').write_text('''<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->

# Closed long-output worker screening samples

Arc B570 10 GiB, Ryzen 5600X, free build, source-built intel/llvm7.1.1,
ordinary persistent serve, no MTP, forced segmented verification, greedy,
32768 input positions and128 generated tokens. The same binary, input, fixed
18 tasks, 144 expert-cache slots and other settings are pinned in each receipt.
The predeclared worker order is5,3,4,4,3,5,3,5,4. This boundary is incomplete:
three independent samples per worker are required before a worker decision.

| Sample | Workers | Prefill ms | Decode ms | Prefill tok/s | Decode tok/s |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
''' + rows + '''

Every listed request is complete, normally closed by QUIT, finite and fault-free,
with observed/reaped/empty owned sessions and fresh pre/post health checks.
They are operational speed samples. Quality stays unevaluated and unqualified;
no worker setting or new inference implementation is adopted. Full128 reported
tokens and LP5 happen to match, but generated output identity is not the general
quality criterion. Full-vocabulary fixed-history likelihood/distribution and
held-out task comparison remain separate work. Different generated histories
could also change the timing workload; that limitation is retained.

The first v4 attempt failed before model launch because Main's health parser
incorrectly required one LIBRARY row per path. The actual probe was successful:
29 mapping-segment rows described seven exact pinned libraries. v5 accepts a
bounded repeated segment representation while still rejecting missing/extra
library identities. The original failure receipt is unchanged. v5 passes eight
CPU fixtures twice plus owned normal-QUIT and STOP/cancellation mock checks;
Python lint comparison has no new findings, while original baseline findings
and their nonzero lint exits remain recorded.

R330 confirms that this actual no-MTP, no-suffix, no-lookup serve route invokes
Verifier::run with T=1 per token. R329's standalone remaining-window explanation
does not apply here. --adapt-swaps0 also excludes the adaptive-swap theory.
R328 identifies caller participation as a possible later existing-knob arm,
after the worker matrix. No scheduling or maximum-output causal claim is made.
R331 finds a strict fixed-history CPU comparator gap; its standalone scoring
route is not a qualified serve quality test. R322 corrects persistent Prefill
lifecycle; growing decode cache needs a real VMM owner and safe next-GEN return.
The two implementation packets remain immutable source-only proposals.

Original source, admission and model receipts stay byte-identical for the
ongoing nine-sample controller. Committed copies identify a public typed-hash
transformation. Duplicate successful command logs are retired only after their
required evidence is verified; each deletion has a path/hash/reason manifest.
Model/context fixtures, current source packets and provider/binary pins remain.
Full262144-input, RESTORE, whole-model quality, optimized official parameters,
contrib-llvm model qualification and the1000/70 tok/s goal remain open.
''')
        deletion = []
        # Only closed roots from this cohort; never traverse an active campaign.
        for root, data, replacement in closed_roots:
            for path in sorted((root / 'commands').glob('*')):
                if path.is_file() and path.suffix in ('.stdout', '.stderr'):
                    deletion.append(dict(path=str(path), bytes=path.stat().st_size, sha256=m.sha(path),
                                         retained_replacement=replacement,
                                         supplementary_evidence=('individual-samples.json' if '/main-long-decode128-root-v5/' in str(root)
                                                                 else 'resolved-health-parser-evidence.json' if '/main-long-decode128-root-v4/' in str(root) else None),
                                         reason='Closed run: protocol/status/ownership and relevant diagnostic evidence recorded; duplicate successful commands or filtered unrelated journal output.'))
            if '/main-long-decode128-root-v5/' in str(root) and data['worker_sample'] != 1:
                path = root / 'tokens.txt'
                reference = B / 'main-long-decode128-root-v5/sample-1-workers-5-gu-unchanged/xe-timed1-on/tokens.txt'
                assert m.sha(path) == m.sha(reference) == data['input']['sha256']
                deletion.append(dict(path=str(path), bytes=path.stat().st_size, sha256=m.sha(path),
                                     retained_replacement=str(reference),
                                     reason='Identical current32K input; retain one canonical32K copy plus canonical64K parent and recorded derivation. Campaign reads prior receipts, not prior input copies.'))
        dump(F / 'retention-manifest.json', dict(
            deletions=deletion, planned=True, deleted=False,
            pinned_private_receipts_retained=True, active_runs_touched=False,
            ongoing_consumer='v5 worker-long-decode campaign prefix admission, samples1..9',
            byte_budget=8 << 20, next_review='After all nine samples are closed and compared',
            deletion_scope='Explicit closed roots only; no tensor, fixture, source, model, service or GPU mutation'))
        paths = [str(p.relative_to(W)) for p in sorted(F.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()]
        lint = run('report-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh', *paths])
        assert 'skipped (' not in lint
        run('diff-check', ['git', 'diff', '--check', 'HEAD'])
        # Verify every public derivation and original receipt before retiring logs.
        for item in derivations:
            assert m.sha(Path(item['original_path'])) == item['original_sha256']
            assert m.sha(F / item['public_path']) == item['public_sha256']
        for item in deletion:
            path = Path(item['path'])
            assert path.stat().st_size == item['bytes'] and m.sha(path) == item['sha256']
        for item in deletion:
            Path(item['path']).unlink()
        manifest = json.loads((F / 'retention-manifest.json').read_text())
        manifest.update(planned=False, deleted=True, removed_logical_bytes=sum(x['bytes'] for x in deletion),
                        removed_file_count=len(deletion), free_space_claim=False)
        dump(F / 'retention-manifest.json', manifest)
        run('stage-report', ['git', 'add', '--', str(F.relative_to(W))])
        run('commit-report', ['git', 'commit', '-m', 'perf(bench): record closed 32k long-decode worker samples'])
        r['commit'] = run('committed-head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
        run('push-report', ['git', 'push', '-u', 'origin', 'perf/native-copy-cohorts-qualified-20261012'])
        assert not run('final-status', ['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
        r.update(passed=True, complete=True)
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ['passed', 'error', 'commit']}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
